title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-3285 located at 7262 West Waring Avenue, westerly of Alta Vista…
text:
[Council File 26-1418; CD 5]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-3285 located at 7262 West Waring Avenue, westerly of Alta Vista Boulevard.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-3285, located at 7262 West Waring Avenue, westerly of Alta Vista Boulevard.
Owner: Shabse Twerski and Leah Miller (A)(O); Surveyor: Peter Riechers
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $16,500.00 for the processing of this final tract map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
